reviews.title: This price point is crazy for something this good
reviews.comment: This is honestly really crazy for $30. The heat sink is really high quality, I like that the fins are blacked out. It matches my setup really well. The screen is VERY nice for what it is. Very crisp and you get a million different choices on what to set it as, or you can use a custom image. You do have to set it back to what you originally setup every time you boot, but the software is really fast so it doesn't really bother me that much. The only complaint I have, though this is probably my fault, is that the screws included for AMD were the wrong thread for the backplate I have. That being said, I don't have a factory back plate anymore, so it might be the right thread for a factory back plate but not the one I have. Thankfully the included Intel screws worked just fine.
reviews.author: Jaden Gilray

reviews.title: $30 is crazy imo.
reviews.comment:
Really great "budget" cooler at least for what it is. You get a screen on a air cooler that in its self is cool. Now you can customize it with gifs and it cools your CPU. That's crazy for $30 imo.
Now I will say the software isn't great. It's works overall but I do wish it was just little more refined. I still unable to get my gifs and stuff to be saved on boot up. No big deal as I can manually load the saved themes I made. Might also be user issue.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: It looks great
reviews.comment: It looks great visually. The software is easy to install and use. Wiring wise it requires a few cables and you should plan for wire management if you want a clean look.  It uses the motherboard 9 Pin usb for data and a sata PSU cable for power THEN ON TOP OF THAT separately it uses a 3 pin ARGB 5v cable for the fans LEDs and also a CPU 3 pin cable for actual fan speed management. Yikes. Still highly recommend
reviews.author: H.Marquez

reviews.title: Works great but make sure your case is big enough for it!
reviews.comment: I like this fan, the LCD screen works great but you do have to have the program running in the back ground for it to show on the screen. Make sure you check the dimensions of your case before you buy this cooler because it is BIG. Also make sure it will clear your ram. It looks greats and I use this for a AM4 Ryzen 5800xt. That one runs hot but this holds it at just the right temp. It is not too loud either but I did change out the fan to a better quality ARGB fan.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: How is this only $30 bucks
reviews.comment: This cooler is amazing for this price. It's even cooler if you add another fan to it just make sure it's a reverse flow fan. It keeps my ryzen 5800x3d nice and cool. And the screen on it has sooo many customizable options it's actually insane. It is super easy to install besides fighting all the wires that come from it. I highly recommend this cooler by far over any other brand. The screen adds a cool factor that just can't be beat. Plus the software for the screen is super easy to operate.
reviews.author: Chrisley lewis
